# Pull request

## Linked issue

Closes #

## Outcome

Describe the observable user or operator outcome. Do not use implementation details as evidence.

## Architecture and security boundaries

Describe affected authority classes, trust boundaries, persisted contracts, provider/runtime
coupling, and explicit non-goals. Write `None` only after checking each category.

## Failure modes

List failure, cancellation, timeout, partial-effect, compatibility, and recovery cases considered.

## Verification

Map each acceptance criterion to its runnable command or observable evidence. Include RED, GREEN,
and REFACTOR evidence for behavior changes.

- [ ] Formatting, linting, and type checking pass.
- [ ] Unit and integration tests pass.
- [ ] The production build and relevant runtime smoke tests pass.
- [ ] Package and dependency-security checks pass when applicable.

## Documentation

List updated public contracts, operational guidance, decision records, and third-party notices, or
explain why none changed.
